answers.product: Coordinate measuring machines (CMM) for automotive parts plants

advisor-profile.stage: 60 staff, Nagoya. ¥1.8B revenue; exports to Thailand and Indonesia; no India presence yet
advisor-profile.products: Bridge-type coordinate measuring machines (CMM) and inspection software for machined automotive parts: engine blocks, gear housings, brake components
advisor-profile.usp: ±1.5 µm accuracy at 30% lower price than European CMMs; inspection cycle 25% faster with our software
advisor-profile.customers: Japanese tier-1 auto suppliers in Japan, Thailand and Indonesia
advisor-profile.buyerType: Tier-1 / tier-2 auto-component plants in Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra (B2B)
advisor-profile.investment: Limited initial commitment (≈ ₹40 lakh for the pilot)
advisor-profile.modify: Software menus and labels yes; hardware no; Indian voltage and dust protection kit possible
advisor-profile.capacity: 15 machines a month; minimum order 1 machine
advisor-profile.ip: Patents in Japan and Thailand; no exclusive distributors in Asia
advisor-profile.timeline: Paying pilot customer within 6 months; low risk tolerance
advisor-profile.notes: We cannot install or service in India ourselves: we need a partner with field engineers (service model B).

coach-form.message: お世話になっております。先日ご提案いただいた独占販売の件、社内で前向きに検討させていただきます。少しお時間をいただけますと幸いです。今後ともよろしくお願いいたします。

negotiate-form.product: Coordinate measuring machines for automotive parts plants
negotiate-form.position: Exclusivity in Tamil Nadu only for 12 months; on-site response within 24h; advance payment on the first order
